complete_examples.text: Section 5 presents three numerical examples to demonstrate the application of the proposed methods: the influence of far-field soil finite element size on simulation results, the distribution of near-field and far-field soil vibrations, and the effect of vibration-damping tracks on soil vibrations.
Consequently, identical mesh sizes should not be used for both near-field and far-field soil regions.
